about:
tests/fixtures/regular_live_2026-10-28.json: what tests/test_keycheck.py replays through RegularWatch, from the
live tour telemetries of 2026-10-25 to 28 (lab/telemetry/2026102[5-8]-*-tour.jsonl; read-only). Per run, the events
around each regular press (from WINDOW_BEFORE s before it to WINDOW_AFTER after), time-ordered, times in centiseconds
from the run's first kept event, delta-coded:
  [dt, "s", her x, her y, her platform, [[kind, x, y, platform, bar*1000 or null], ...]]   a look that searched
  [dt, "a", key, kind, x, act]     an attack record (key "attack" or "lucky_seven"; act: the stance's before it)
  [dt, "g", [kinds] or null]       an EXP gain (null: any kind)
  [dt, "k", kind, platform, x]     a kill of hers placed
  [dt, "h"]                        a touch (HP dropped)
Kinds as indices into "kinds".
